messages:
Ivy (AE): Hey team, Prospect: BeaconFinance wants SOC 2 excerpt, proof of EU data residency for backups, a signed pen-test attestation, and confirmation we won't include any KMS material in shared artifacts. They're also asking for a 1-hour unauthenticated scan window next Mon 11:00 CET. Can we support?
Jon (Solutions Eng): I can assemble SOC2 excerpt + a short backups/residency note and a simplified network diagram. Will not include any KMS configs.
Marta (Security): Unauthenticated scan is OK on staging only. Need exact staging hostnames, source IPs, UA, and affirmation that no keys or admin endpoints are in scope. We'll redact internal ticket links before sharing.
Ivy (AE): Beacon contact: secops@beaconfin.com. They sent two IPs: 3.248.12.99, 3.248.12.100. UA: "BeaconProbe/7.2". Hostname: staging-eu.beaconfin.com. Window request Mon 10:50 CET -> 11:50 CET.
Evan (Infra): We can whitelist /32s and schedule open/close. Please confirm expected request rate to avoid autoscale noise and whether they require ASN or agent fingerprint.
Jon (Solutions Eng): Expected low rate (~8 req/s). No ASN required but will provide UA and IPs. I'll prepare presigned package with SOC2 excerpt + EU backup blob statement (no keys).
Marta (Security): Also require the pen-test attestation fields for LegalBot: signer_name, signer_title, company_name, registration_id, testing_scope, desired_return_email. We will only share redacted artifacts once legal finalizes.
Ivy (AE): Filling now: signer_name: Helena Park; signer_title: CISO; company_name: Beacon Finance Ltd; registration_id: GB-12345678; testing_scope: unauthenticated external vuln scan against staging-eu.beaconfin.com only; desired_return_email: secops@beaconfin.com
LegalBot: Received fields. Also require a billing contact and confirmation that Beacon accepts our standard indemnity. Reply with yes/no.
Ivy (AE): Billing contact: billing@beaconfin.com. They accepted standard indemnity.
Jon (Solutions Eng): Uploaded presigned evidence bundle (24h expiry): https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence-temp/beacon/bundle.zip?X-Amz-Expires=86400 
Marta (Security): I'll review the bundle and mark redactions. Important: we will not include any KMS/HSM artifacts or production hostnames.
Evan (Infra): Scheduling firewall: open 3.248.12.99/32 and 3.248.12.100/32 at Mon 10:45 CET, close at 11:55 CET. Adding alerts and rollback if traffic >120 r/s.
LegalBot: Drafting signed pen-test attestation now. Expect signed PDF within 48 hours after internal review and redaction confirmation.
Ivy (AE): Thanks everyone  passing to Beacon: secops@beaconfin.com. I'll share signed attestation when LegalBot returns it. :thumbsup:
